title: Sphinx enclosure opening said to connect to the Queen's Chamber

tellings.quote: For example, there are three openings on the back of the Sphinx enclosure. One of which has been corroborated by a friend of mine in the Egyptian Ministry of Antiquities to connect into the Queen's Chamber of the Great Pyramid

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a man who has his own theory about what the Egyptian pyramids were for, says there are three openings at the back of the sunken area that surrounds the Sphinx at Giza. He says a friend who works in Egypt's Ministry of Antiquities, the government body that runs the country's ancient sites, has confirmed that one of these openings leads into the Queen's Chamber, a room inside the Great Pyramid. If so, it would mean hidden passages link the two monuments.
